# EditedEphemeralMessageHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.EditedEphemeralMessageHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The EditedEphemeralMessage handler class. Used to handle edited ephemeral messages. It is intended to be
used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_edited_ephemeral_message`](../decorators/on_edited_ephemeral_message.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when an ephemeral message is edited. It takes *(client,
  edited_ephemeral_message)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed
  description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    edited_ephemeral_message ([`EphemeralMessage`](../types/messages_and_media/EphemeralMessage.md)):
        The edited ephemeral message.
